Two members of Trump's cabinet—Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent—remained aboard an aircraft designated as Air Force One in Turkey last month while President Trump secretly transferred to a separate military plane via a catering truck due to security concerns invo

By imposing high security risks on unwitting personnel without advance notice, the operation prioritized central authority over transparent coalition safety. Secretive tactical pretexts replaced shared situational awareness.

When you map the gap between stated security protocols and unconsenting risk exposure, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Tactical secrecy suppresses participant autonomy.

The Unavoidable Truth: High-risk presidential travel demands extreme and unconventional security ruses.

The Unavoidable Lie: Unwitting staff and reporters on decoy flights face zero collateral security exposure.
